module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  input p1e,
  input p1f,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  wire n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6;

  // p2y logic
  and (n1, p2a, p2b);       // First AND gate for p2
  and (n2, p2c, p2d);       // Second AND gate for p2
  or  (n3, n1, n2);         // OR gate combining p2c_p2d and p2a_p2b
  not (p2y, n3);            // Final NOT gate for p2y output

  // p1y logic
  and (n4, p1a, p1b);       // First AND gate for p1
  and (n5, p1c, p1d);       // Second AND gate for p1
  or  (n6, n4, n5);         // OR gate combining p1c_p1d and p1a_p1b
  and (p1y, n6, p1e, p1f);  // Final AND gate for p1y output

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input slowena,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      q <= 4'b0000;
    end else if (slowena) begin
      if (q == 4'b1001) begin
        q <= 4'b0000;
      end else begin
        q <= q + 1;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input resetn,
  input [1:0] byteena,
  input [15:0] d,
  output reg [15:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
  if (!resetn) begin
    q <= 16'b0;
  end else begin
    if (byteena[0]) begin
      q[7:0] <= d[7:0];
    end
    if (byteena[1]) begin
      q[15:8] <= d[15:8];
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  always @(*) begin
    out = ((~c & d) | (a & b));
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output reg out
);

  wire nand_ab, or_cd, and_final;
  
  assign nand_ab = ~(a & b); // NAND gate for inputs a and b
  assign or_cd = c | d;      // OR gate for inputs c and d
  assign and_final = nand_ab & or_cd; // AND gate combining outputs of previous gates
  
  always @(*) begin
    out = ~and_final;  // NOT gate for final output
  end

endmodule

module ROM (
    input wire [7:0] addr,        // 8-bit Address input
    output reg [15:0] dout        // 16-bit Data output
);

    always @(*) begin
        case (addr[3:0])          // Select based on only lower 4 bits of the address
            4'b0000: dout = 16'h0000;  // Output for address 0
            4'b0001: dout = 16'h0001;  // Output for address 1
            4'b0010: dout = 16'h0002;  // Output for address 2
            4'b0011: dout = 16'h0003;  // Output for address 3
            4'b0100: dout = 16'h0004;  // Output for address 4
            4'b0101: dout = 16'h0005;  // Output for address 5
            4'b0110: dout = 16'h0006;  // Output for address 6
            4'b0111: dout = 16'h0007;  // Output for address 7
            4'b1000: dout = 16'h0008;  // Output for address 8
            4'b1001: dout = 16'h0009;  // Output for address 9
            4'b1010: dout = 16'h000A;  // Output for address 10
            4'b1011: dout = 16'h000B;  // Output for address 11
            4'b1100: dout = 16'h000C;  // Output for address 12
            4'b1101: dout = 16'h000D;  // Output for address 13
            4'b1110: dout = 16'h000E;  // Output for address 14
            4'b1111: dout = 16'h000F;  // Output for address 15
            default: dout = 16'h0000;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
